testCase.name: [local] S20 Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

descriptionHtml:
Bug A1 · P2 · accessibility

Buttons, inputs and dropdowns have no accessible name (Nursing Home +, settings, back, close X, task done/delete, medication status dropdown); also some focus jumps to the top and small tap targets

Tickets: — · counts as a QA bug: yes · found on: local (visual check)

Other cases of the same bug (counted once): OAT-01/S21, OAT-06/S24b, TC-03/S21, TC-11/S20, TC-12/S20, TC-14/S22, TC-19/S21, TC-21/S20

Approach · TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · S20 Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • T2 Tasks closed by dictation show as completed, with the visit they were closed on (TFA-92585 AC 8) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U8 All of the above in Nursing Home as well as Hospital, passing in both (UAT TC-22 step 4; UAT 3.3; TFA-92592 AC 14) — gate: blocked: TFA-92592 ready for pr

Test design technique: Accessibility (accessibility) — Check screen-reader, keyboard, contrast and tap-size rules (axe): users with disabilities have to be able to use it too.

Given Hospital and Nursing Home charts with one open and one closed task; Post-Round → Tasks and Task Export (Finished Tasks expanded)

When Visual lane runs axe-core on each screen (desktop, Pixel 7, iPhone 15)

Then Every task toggle on the four screens has an accessible name that contains the task text and exposes its state (aria-pressed or aria-checked); no serious or critical axe violation; whether done is shown by colour or strike-through alone goes to a person

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): A scripted DOM check on each screen: for every task toggle, accessible name ⊇ task text and aria-pressed / aria-checked present and matching the stored done state (WCAG 4.1.2). Expected Fail on main for the Nursing Home Post-Round toggles (no name, no state) and both Task Export screens (title 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' only: no task text, no state); …

Where it ran: local visual lane (screenshots + axe); test method VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person); lane planned in the matrix: visual / mobile (blocked)

S20 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-22.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Triage (2026-10-14): 1 row.

Issue type: Accessibility · environment local · tickets TFA-92585 ready for pr; TFA-92592 ready for pr

A screen-reader user on the Nursing Home Post-Round tasks or on Task Export hears the same unnamed button for every task and cannot tell which task it is or whether it is done.

Evidence: allure-results/d6815fdc…: 6 pass / 30 fail across 3 profiles. Hospital Post-Round toggles pass ('Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' with aria-pressed). NH Post-Round toggles have no name and no state. Both Task Export screens say 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' with no task text and no aria-pressed (WCAG 4.1.2).

Environment: local — main e02167f, local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane visual.

Test method: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: visual.

UAT item: TC-22 Task Closure & Extraction · Section: A5 · Cross-Cutting · Scenario: TC-22/S20

Task toggles in both contexts are named with their task and expose done / not done; axe on the task screens

Tickets: TFA-92585 Task Export (ready for pr); TFA-92592 In-Room Dictation & Note Generation (ready for pr)

New local lane visual: status failed in visual/results.json → failed · product (failed · product (the lane flagged a product issue)).

How it is tested (visual/plan.json, automatable: partly): encounter.spec.ts: one done + one open task per context; Post-Round → tasks and Task Export with Finished expanded; toggle name contains the task and aria-pressed/checked matches done; axe serious/critical. — Done shown by colour / strike-through alone (WCAG 1.4.1) is a person's screenshot review.

Detail:

desktop, iphone15, pixel7: 6 judged check(s) passed, 30 failed. Hospital Post-Round passes: 'Complete task: …' / 'Reopen task: …' with aria-pressed matching done.

Product issue: Nursing Home Post-Round task toggles have no name and no state; both Task Export screens use 'Mark task done' / 'Undo — move back to pending' without the task text and without aria-pressed — a screen-reader user hears the same label for every task and cannot tell which is done (oracle predicted exactly this Fail, WCAG 4.1.2).

Evidence: 8 attached; 1 not attached:

  • visual/evidence/TC-22_S20 — a folder (27 items), not attached

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — Lane V: visual-lane.ts reads a make-session.ts fixture (a fresh local account made with the admin key), and make-session.ts refuses dev, so it runs on the local stack only (2026-10-14).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
